notes.title: Ver1.11 Released!!
notes.content:
Ver1.11 is Released!

This is minor update such as graphic adjustment and balance adjustment.

The effects and drop rate of some items have been adjusted.

To prevent accidents at the start,
reduced block spacing and prevented enemies from spawning immediately after the start.

Increased variation of background cloud.

notes.title: Ver1.10 Released!!
notes.content:
Ver1.10 Released!!

Added new item "extra jump".
A star with wing item is dropping on the block.
It's enabled to jump extra after jumping in the air.
The remaining count is indicated by small stars around player.

Added background graphic variation.

Adjusted balances of various items.

notes.title: Ver1.01 Released
notes.content:
Ver1.01 has been released.

Updated content is to fix the problem that the block may be biased to one side, as well as adjusting the overall balance by changing the number of blocks, obstacles, items etc arranged.
And the quality of background graphics improved.

I plan to continue such balance adjustment and detailed brush up.
Although it becomes little by little, I want to make it a more enjoyable game.

notes.title: Ponkle Released!
notes.content:
Ponkle was released today!

I created this game for easy casual enjoyment and challenging.
I hope you enjoy it.
